name: 霸者的独揽
desc: 对方准备阶段才能发动。发动回合对方不能进行战斗阶段。
faq: When you activate "Thunder of Ruler", since your opponent cannot enter the Battle Phase, your opponent proceeds from Main Phase 1 to the End Phase.
ruling: If Main Phase 1 is also skipped after the effect of “Thunder of Ruler,” the affected player will not receive a Main Phase 2.
